intro R L 
intro [field_R] [lie_ring_L] [lie_algebra_R_L] [finite_dim] [is_killing]
let ad : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ L := LieDerivation.ad R L
haveI : IsLieAlgebra R L := lie_algebra_R_L
haveI : IsLieRing L := lie_ring_L
haveI : IsModule R L := Module.Finite.toModule finite_dim
haveI : IsLieAlgebra R (↥(ad.range)) := by
  apply LieAlgebra.ofRange
  exact is_killing
apply is_killing
